SELECT w.id, w.workspace_id, w.name, w.description, w.enabled, w.runtime_owner, w.archived_at, w.intake_paused_at, w.intake_paused_by_id, w.draft_revision, w.draft_record_type AS record_type, w.draft_execution_mode AS execution_mode, w.draft_run_as_user_id AS run_as_user_id, w.active_version_id, active_version.version_number AS active_version_number, active_version.published_at AS active_version_published_at, JSON_LENGTH(w.draft_definition_json, '$.nodes') AS node_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JSON_TABLE( w.draft_definition_json, '$.nodes[*]' COLUMNS(node_type VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.type') ) draft_node WHERE draft_node.node_type = 'ACTION' ) AS action_count, canonical_run.id AS canonical_run_id, canonical_run.status AS canonical_run_status, canonical_run.started_at AS canonical_run_started_at, canonical_run.finished_at AS canonical_run_finished_at, legacy_run.id AS legacy_run_id, legacy_run.status AS legacy_run_status, legacy_run.executed_at AS legacy_run_executed_at, w.created_by_id, w.updated_by_id, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workflow w LEFT JOIN workflow_version active_version ON active_version.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND active_version.workflow_id = w.id AND active_version.id = w.active_version_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT wr.id, wr.status, wr.started_at, wr.finished_at FROM workflow_run wr WHERE wr.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND wr.workflow_id = w.id ORDER BY wr.started_at DESC, wr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) canonical_run ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT re.id, re.status, re.executed_at FROM rule_execution re WHERE re.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND re.rule_id = w.legacy_rule_id ORDER BY re.executed_at DESC, re.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) legacy_run ON TRUE WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.archived_at IS NOT NULLNULL ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC, w.id DESC
SELECT FROM workflow WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM workflow WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND legacy_rule_id = #{legacyRuleId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow (workspace_id, legacy_rule_id, name, description, enabled, runtime_owner, archived_at, draft_revision, draft_record_type, draft_execution_mode, draft_run_as_user_id, draft_definition_json, draft_canvas_json, active_version_id, created_by_id, updated_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{legacyRuleId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{runtimeOwner}, #{archivedAt}, #{draftRevision}, #{draftRecordType}, #{draftExecutionMode}, #{draftRunAsUserId}, #{draftDefinitionJson}, #{draftCanvasJson}, #{activeVersionId}, #{createdById}, #{updatedById})
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET name = #{workflow.name}, description = #{workflow.description}, draft_revision = draft_revision + 1, draft_record_type = #{workflow.draftRecordType}, draft_execution_mode = #{workflow.draftExecutionMode}, draft_run_as_user_id = #{workflow.draftRunAsUserId}, draft_definition_json = #{workflow.draftDefinitionJson}, draft_canvas_json = #{workflow.draftCanvasJson}, updated_by_id = #{workflow.updatedById} WHERE workspace_id = #{workflow.workspaceId} AND id = #{workflow.id} AND archived_at IS NULL AND draft_revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT w.id FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.id = w.active_version_id WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.runtime_owner = 'canonical' AND w.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND v.trigger_type = #{triggerType} ORDER BY w.id

SELECT DISTINCT w.workspace_id FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.id = w.active_version_id WHERE w.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND v.trigger_type = 'schedule' ORDER BY w.workspace_id
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET enabled = FALSE, runtime_generation = runtime_generation + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE
